caustica.status.ultraScreenshot.requires: Ultra screenshot requires an active world
Ultra screenshot requires ray tracing, DLSS Ray Reconstruction, and Debug View Off
caustica.status.screenshot.busy: Screenshot capture is already in progress
caustica.status.ultraScreenshot.invalida: Ultra screenshot cancelled because render state changed
caustica.status.ultraScreenshot.failed: Ultra screenshot cancelled because rendering failed
caustica.status.ultraScreenshot.timedOut: Ultra screenshot cancelled after 30 seconds without a fresh DLSS frame
caustica.status.ultraScreenshot.resized: Ultra screenshot cancelled because resolution changed
caustica.options.rt.exposureMode.tooltip: How the ray-traced image is mapped to display brightness. Auto adapts to scene luminance; Manual uses the exposure value directly.
caustica.options.rt.manualEv.tooltip: Exposure compensation in stops. In Manual, this is the fixed exposure. In Auto, this biases the auto exposure brighter or darker.
caustica.options.rt.exposureLowPercentil: Ignores darker histogram samples below this percentile.
caustica.options.rt.exposureHighPercenti: Ignores brighter histogram samples above this percentile.
caustica.options.rt.preExposure.tooltip: Scale ray-traced radiance before the fp16 write and remove the same scale before display mapping.
caustica.options.rt.gamma.tooltip: Post-transform luminance gamma. Values below 1.00 brighten shadows and midtones while preserving black, white, and color ratios.
caustica.options.rt.spp.tooltip: Path-tracing samples taken per pixel each frame. Higher is cleaner but more demanding.
caustica.options.rt.maxBounces.tooltip: Maximum number of secondary path-tracing bounces after the primary hit. Higher captures more indirect light but costs more.
caustica.options.rt.risCandidates.toolti: Emitter candidates tested per diffuse vertex. Higher values reduce torch and glow-light noise but cost more ray-tracing work; zero disables RIS.
caustica.options.rt.entities.tooltip: Include entities and block entities in the ray-traced scene.
caustica.options.rt.particles.tooltip: Draw particles as camera-ray billboards inside the traced scene.
caustica.options.rt.glow.tooltip: Draw the vanilla Glowing-effect outline (through walls) around glowing entities.
caustica.options.rt.waterWaves.tooltip: Animate water-surface normals for moving wave highlights.
caustica.options.rt.hdr.tooltip: Recreate the swapchain for HDR (ST.2084/PQ) or native SDR output. Applied at the next frame boundary.
caustica.options.rt.hdrUiBrightness.tool: Absolute brightness (in nits) assigned to SDR-authored UI on an HDR display.
caustica.options.rt.hdrPeak.tooltip: Absolute brightness (in nits) highlights roll off toward. Set to your display's peak HDR brightness; the control moves in 50-nit increments.
caustica.options.rt.toneMappingMenu.tool: Open exposure, output mapping, and active tone-mapper controls.
caustica.options.rt.toneMapping.title: Exposure & Tone Mapping
caustica.options.rt.toneMapping.resetHin: Ctrl+Shift+click an option to reset it to default
caustica.options.rt.sdrToneMapper.toolti: Selects the SDR display transform. ACES 2.0 is the default; PsychoV24 and the analytical operators are opt-in.
caustica.options.rt.hdrToneMapper.toolti: Selects the HDR10/PQ display transform. ACES 2.0 is the default; PsychoV24 is opt-in and BT.2390 is the standards-based alternative.
caustica.options.rt.hdrPaperWhite.toolti: Absolute brightness in nits assigned to scene paper white before HDR headroom.
caustica.options.rt.agxContrast.tooltip: Contrast adjustment after the reference AgX transform.
caustica.options.rt.agxSaturation.toolti: Saturation adjustment after the reference AgX transform.
Luminance at which PBR Neutral begins highlight compression.
caustica.options.rt.reinhardWhitePoint.t: Luminance mapped to display white by extended Reinhard.
caustica.options.rt.acesInputScale.toolt: Input scale for the compact ACES fitted operator.
caustica.options.rt.lottesContrast.toolt: Contrast exponent for the Lottes filmic curve.
caustica.options.rt.lottesShoulder.toolt: Shoulder exponent for the Lottes filmic curve.
caustica.options.rt.lottesHdrMax.tooltip: HDR maximum used to normalize the Lottes curve.
caustica.options.rt.lottesMidIn.tooltip: Input midpoint anchor for the Lottes curve.
caustica.options.rt.lottesMidOut.tooltip: Output midpoint anchor for the Lottes curve.
caustica.options.rt.unchartedShoulderStr: Shoulder strength in the Uncharted 2 curve.
caustica.options.rt.unchartedLinearStren: Linear strength in the Uncharted 2 curve.
caustica.options.rt.unchartedLinearAngle: Linear angle in the Uncharted 2 curve.
caustica.options.rt.unchartedToeStrength: Toe strength in the Uncharted 2 curve.
caustica.options.rt.unchartedToeNumerato: Toe numerator in the Uncharted 2 curve.
caustica.options.rt.unchartedToeDenomina: Toe denominator in the Uncharted 2 curve.
White point used to normalize Uncharted 2.
caustica.options.rt.gtContrast.tooltip: Contrast parameter for the GT/Uchimura curve.
caustica.options.rt.gtLinearStart.toolti: Start of the linear section in the GT curve.
caustica.options.rt.gtLinearLength.toolt: Length of the linear section in the GT curve.
caustica.options.rt.gtBlackCurve.tooltip: Black toe curvature in the GT curve.
caustica.options.rt.gtBlackLift.tooltip: Black-level lift in the GT curve.
caustica.options.rt.psychov24GamutCompre: Compresses out-of-gamut PsychoV24 colors toward the display gamut.
Grades PsychoV24 values above the adaptation anchor.
caustica.options.rt.psychov24Shadows.too: Grades PsychoV24 values below the adaptation anchor.
caustica.options.rt.dlssQuality.tooltip: DLSS Ray Reconstruction quality mode. Lower-quality modes render fewer pixels and upscale more aggressively for higher framerates; higher-quality modes render more pixels for a sharper image. Only affects the image when DLSS Ray Reconstruction is enabled.
caustica.options.rt.debugView.tooltip: Inspect ray-tracing buffers and exposure diagnostics after the normal frame has rendered.
caustica.options.rt.sharcMenu.title: SHaRC Settings
caustica.options.rt.sharcMenu.status.lay: Compiled layout: directional SH; primary debug is opt-in
caustica.options.rt.sharcEnabled.tooltip: Use the optional NVIDIA SHaRC 1.8 directional-SH cache for eligible diffuse indirect lighting.
caustica.options.rt.sharcCacheExponent.t: Number of SHaRC hash-grid entries as a power of two. Larger values consume more GPU memory and clear the cache when changed.
caustica.options.rt.sharcPrimarySurfaceD: Developer comparison mode that permits SHaRC on the camera-visible terminal surface. Off keeps the primary surface live.
caustica.options.rt.sharcAntiFirefly.too: Apply confidence-based weighting only to SHaRC cache updates; the live path estimator is unchanged.
Pixels covered by one sparse SHaRC update ray. Larger tiles reduce update cost but refresh fewer entries per frame.
caustica.options.rt.sharcAccumulationFra: Temporal accumulation window used by the SHaRC cache.
caustica.options.rt.sharcStaleFrames.too: Frames without a new sample before SHaRC may evict an entry.
caustica.options.rt.sharcSceneScale.tool: World scale used when selecting SHaRC spatial hash-grid levels.
caustica.options.rt.sharcRadianceScale.t: Quantization scale at the directional-radiance encoding boundary.
caustica.options.rt.sharcRoughnessThresh: Additional minimum linear roughness for diffuse SHaRC ownership. Zero preserves the mirror cutoff.
caustica.options.rt.sharcGridLogarithmBa: Base used to select the SHaRC hash-grid level from distance.
caustica.options.rt.sharcGridLevelBias.t: Bias applied to the selected SHaRC hash-grid level.
